name: interface-design
conclusion: interface-design (Ask) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 3 clarification rules, 7 approval gates, 9 validation rules; none for autonomy limits, escalation rules. Strongest: validation rules.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 3 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose: unclear intent, task or feeling; ambiguity before acting.

statements.quote: **Intent** — Identify who, what task, what feeling (ask user if unclear)
If you cannot answer these with specifics, stop. Ask the user. Do not guess.
**Surface ambiguity before acting — don't pick silently.**

approval_gates.conclusion: 7 approval gates (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: skipping or reordering steps; direction buy-in before building; saving patterns or skipping steps on request.

statements.quote: NEVER skip, reorder, or merge steps without explicit user approval.
**Propose Direction** — Present exploration + direction, get user buy-in
Lead with your exploration and recommendation, then confirm:
When you finish building something, **always offer to save**:
For simple tasks, AI MUST ATTENTION ask user whether to skip.

**IMPORTANT MUST ATTENTION** follow declared step order for this skill; NEVER skip, reorder, or merge steps without explicit user approval **IMPORTANT MUST ATTENTION** for every step/sub-skill call: s

validation.conclusion: 9 validation rules (9 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: evidence for each completed step; mandate checks before showing output; verifying generated content and all outputs.

statements.quote: **[BLOCKING]** Every completed/skipped step MUST include brief evidence or explicit skip reason.
**Evaluate** — Run mandate checks (swap, squint, signature, token tests) before showing
Run 4 mandate checks before showing output to user
**Before showing the user, look at what you made.**
Run these against your output before presenting:
If any check fails, iterate before showing.
**Verify ALL affected outputs, not just the first.**
**MANDATORY IMPORTANT MUST ATTENTION** add a final review todo task to verify work quality
